contract.title: Filter stale Product Owner gate authorities during successor arbitration
prohibited_actions: Delete, rewrite, move, suppress or fabricate authority history
Bypass Product Owner confirmation or authentication
Weaken claim, replay, expiry, lineage or fail-closed controls
acceptance_criteria: Exclude stale expected_head authorities from the executable candidate set while retaining them auditable
Select a unique newest current-HEAD successor only when semantic bindings are equivalent
Block genuinely competing current-HEAD authorities and when no valid current authority exists
Preserve claims, replay resistance, expiry, lineage validation and parent immutability
Add all specified stale/current arbitration and history-preservation adversarial tests
